title: Arc testimonial
description: A near-black band laid over a faint 76px square grid: a tall portrait on the left, a 30px regular-weight quote with a hanging opening mark on the right and a small dimmed attribution under it. On phones the portrait is centred above the quote. The quote fades and rises 15px as it scrolls into view.
notes: always dark: it puts the `dark` class on itself and uses the theme's dark muted colour
the portrait slot is a placeholder until you pass media
